neighbours.label: swimming-stroke context, tokens just before a stroke or event name
fire: Most beginners at the pool learn the freestyle before anything else.
She won gold in the 100m butterfly and set a new record.
His coach wants him to improve his backstroke and his turns.
The relay team swam the medley in under four minutes.
In the final she dominated the 200m breaststroke from the start.
Recreational swimmers mostly stick to the front crawl.
The club offers lessons in butterfly, backstroke and breaststroke.
He broke the national record in the 400m freestyle.
quiet: Most beginners at the gym learn the squat before anything else.
She won gold in the 100m hurdles and set a new record.
His coach wants him to improve his serve and his footwork.
The relay team ran the course in under four minutes.
In the final she dominated the 200m sprint from the start.
Recreational runners mostly stick to the flat roads.
The club offers lessons in tennis, squash and badminton.
He broke the national record in the 400m hurdles.

notes: card: + pole sits on swimming text before stroke names; - pole is the token ' sw'.
